Plot expression or numeric metadata in spatial coordinates

Source: R/plot_spatial.R
sn_plot_spatial_feature.Rd

Features share one continuous scale across all panels. Assay/layer selection is exact: a missing layer errors instead of falling back to counts. Missing requested features warn; no available features is an error. Numeric metadata takes precedence over a gene with the same name.

Usage

sn_plot_spatial_feature(
  object,
  features,
  spatial_cols = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  point_size = 1.5,
  cells = NULL,
  split_by = NULL,
  images = NULL,
  cols = NULL,
  palette = "viridis",
  pt_size = NULL,
  alpha = 1,
  na_value = "grey80",
  limits = NULL,
  order = TRUE,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_axis = FALSE,
  show_border = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  flip_y = TRUE,
  raster = FALSE,
  raster_dpi = 512,
  style = "classic"
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object.

features

Gene names or numeric metadata columns, in panel order.

spatial_cols

Two numeric metadata columns in x, y order. Recognized metadata coordinates take precedence over native images unless images is supplied. Coordinates are never rescaled or registered across sections.

assay, layer

Expression assay and exact layer. Metadata-only maps do not require an expression layer.

point_size

Point size in mm; retained for positional compatibility.

cells

Optional cell names to plot, in the requested order.

split_by

Metadata column identifying sections or panels. Required to separate sections when using metadata coordinates; no sample column is guessed.

images

Optional Seurat image/FOV names. Native images are used when metadata coordinates are absent. Each image is plotted separately using full-resolution Visium coordinates or FOV centroids; histology and cell segmentation outlines are not drawn. Overlapping image cell sets are rejected.

cols

Explicit colors; named vectors match categorical labels. For feature maps these are gradient colors.

palette

Shennong palette name or color vector.

pt_size

Alias matching sn_plot_dim(). Supply only one size argument.

alpha

Point opacity between zero and one.

na_value

Color for missing group or feature values.

limits

Optional common color limits. Out-of-range colors are clamped; original values remain in the plot data and exported source table.

order

Draw higher values last and missing values first.

show_legend, show_axis, show_border

Show the legend, coordinate axes or panel border.

title

Optional plot title.

ncol

Number of facet columns.

flip_y

Reverse the y axis for image coordinates. Set FALSE for Cartesian coordinates.

raster

Rasterize only point layers with ggrastr; labels stay vector.

raster_dpi

Raster resolution (scalar or vector, whose maximum is used).

style

Presentation preset; see sn_list_plot_styles(). Coordinates, shared limits and source values are unchanged.

Value

A faceted ggplot with fixed spatial aspect and one common color scale.
